pf.license.need: none for the venue itself: the business registration and the owner's ID are on file; nothing is looked up
pf.license.rooms: where the local fire code requires it: each room's occupancy or fire inspection papers, kept with their end dates as the room's papers (S1-81); a room past its date isn't offered
pf.license.staff: no state license for game masters; the business's own training
pf.license.job limits: each room's most players (the owner's own, within its papers)

A.name: Private escape room
A.price: list, the example venue's $32 a player, 4 players at least ($128)
A.length: 60-minute game, plus a 10-minute briefing; 15 minutes to reset the room
A.booked as: a space: one room for one group, 2 to 8 players; a game master must be free to run it

A.name: Team building
A.price: list, $35 a player, 10 to 30 players across 2 to 4 rooms at once, with a 20-minute debrief
A.booked as: several rooms at the same start, for one group
A.money: half as a deposit when booked; the rest on the bill Rosie sends after

A.name: Birthday party
A.price: list, $260 for up to 8 players: a room plus 45 minutes in the party room
A.booked as: a room and the party room
A.money: a $100 deposit when booked; the $160 rest at the counter on the day

B.name: Mobile escape game
B.price: list, $450 for up to 12 players; $25 each extra, up to 30
B.length: 90 minutes, plus 30 minutes to set up
B.booked as: a game master and the game kit, at a set start
B.place: at the customer's place: an office, a school, a home or a hall, with a room and tables for the teams
B.money: a $150 deposit when booked; the $300 rest on the bill Rosie sends after

B.name: Home party escape game
B.booked as: a game master and the game kit

before times: How many players? (sets the room size, the price and how many rooms)
Is anyone under 14? (an adult must play in the room with them)
Which room or theme, if they have one in mind
after a time: The team's name for the leaderboard (optional)
Anything the game master should know? (optional)
secure page only: each player's waiver: a health condition the player chooses to tell (seizures with flashing lights, trouble with stairs or crawling, pregnancy), an emergency contact
a child's name, and the adult playing with them
pf.questions.who may book: an adult books for the group; a parent or guardian books for children; players under 14 play only with an adult in the room; 14 to 17 may play without an adult only with a parent's signed waiver; a teen never books alone (a parent books)

stop words: someone is hurt, can't breathe, chest pain, a seizure now: the 911 safety message, no booking
drunk or high players: not today (turned away at the door)
pf.safety.tell the customer: The door is never locked: anyone can walk out at any time. Some rooms are dark or have flashing lights, stairs or crawling: the room page says which. A game master watches every room on camera for safety and hints.
pf.safety.staff stops: a player in panic or unwell: the game master opens the door and stops the game; a fire alarm: everyone out at once
pf.safety.booking continues: yes, after the safety steps, for anything but an emergency
pf.safety.B: the game is set up indoors; nothing hazardous is brought

pf.first_steps.when: signed on the secure page before the game, or at the door on the day; on file for 12 months
pf.first_steps.who: each player for themselves on their own link; a parent or guardian for each child
pf.first_steps.late: not signed by the start: signs at the door, or doesn't play

pf.visit.check-in: the code at the counter, 15 minutes before the start, for the briefing; the group has one code; names ticked as each player's waiver is checked
pf.visit.phones: players' phones go in a locker during the game (the business's own rule)
pf.visit.changes at the visit: an extra player at the door at $32, if the room has space, OK'd by the person who booked; nothing else is sold in the room
pf.visit.done: the game master marks DONE when the game ends; the group photo is shared only with the players' yes
pf.visit.late: the game ends at its set end; more than 15 minutes late, the owner may cancel the game (the owner's rule)
pf.visit.children: a child plays only with an adult from their group in the room; no child is left at the venue

pf.money.ways: private rooms: paid in full when booked; team building: half as a deposit, rest on the bill; parties: $100 deposit, rest at the counter; B mobile game: $150 deposit, rest on the bill; B home party: paid in full
pf.money.price: per player, with a minimum per room; fewer players on the day pay the same (the owner's rule); an extra player at the door pays $32
pf.money.fees: the owner's own: free cancel or move until 24 hours before; after that or a no-show, the price paid or the deposit is kept, asked of the owner each time
pf.money.two dollars: yes, $2 a booking (one per booking, however many players)
pf.money.discounts: the business's own discount codes on the booking page; gift cards stay the business's own
pf.money.reserved time: a room's game is reserved time, charged in full: a group that stops early or leaves early gets nothing back for time not used (S13-55; any refund is the owner's call); a game the venue stops (a broken prop, a fire alarm) is the venue's side for the part not given

pf.messages.never in a text: a player's health condition, a seizure warning answer, a child's name or age, waiver answers, anything seen on the room cameras
pf.messages.minors: a child's details stay on the secure page; texts go to the adult who booked

pf.staff.skills: game master (trained on each room), host for parties and team events, the B travelling game master
pf.staff.ratios: one game master watches up to 2 rooms at once; a team event has one host per 3 rooms
pf.staff.stand-ins: any game master trained on the room may run it; nobody is named
pf.staff.who OKs: the owner OKs prices, refunds and fees

switches: where the local fire code requires it: each room's occupancy or fire inspection on file
the most players per room: the owner's own, within its papers
pf.rules.cancel: the owner's own rule; suggested: free until 24 hours before

pf.edges.fewer players: the price stays as booked unless the owner says otherwise
pf.edges.late: the game ends at its set end; over 15 minutes late, the owner decides
pf.edges.panic or illness: the door opens at once; the game master helps; the owner is told; nothing about it in texts
pf.edges.capacity: each room is one group at a time; Rosie books only the room times the owner gives it, or reads the venue's own connected booking system
